plain_english_policy: This bill grants tax-exempt status to a specific organization dedicated to voting rights history.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would produce the following policy direction: The National Voting Rights Museum & Institute is legally exempted from paying state income taxes, as well as sales and use taxes at the state, county, and municipal levels in Alabama. This financial relief applies to tax years beginning after December 31, 2009.
sponsorship_supports_position: The bill is sponsored by Senators Figures, Ross, Smitherman, Coleman, Sanders, Dunn, Denton, Little (T), Poole, Barron, Means, Mitchem, and Butler.
evidence_quotes: "This bill would exempt the National Voting Rights Museum & Institute from the payment of any state income tax and any state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes."
"The National Voting Rights Museum & Institute is exempt from the payment of any state income tax and any state, county, and municipal sales and use taxes."
